# FNB58 BLE Monitor

> Browser-based Bluetooth Low Energy monitor for FNIRSI FNB58, FNB48 and FNB38 USB power meters.

## What it does

A single-page web application that connects to FNIRSI FNB-series USB power meters over Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) and displays real-time electrical measurements in the browser. No installation, no account, no server — all data stays in the browser.

## Measurements displayed

- Voltage (V) and current (A)
- Power (W, calculated)
- Accumulated capacity: Ah and Wh
- D+ / D- data line voltages
- Temperature (the meter's own internal sensor)
- Fast-charge protocol detection (PD, QC 2.0/3.0, FCP, SCP, VOOC, PPS, DCP)

## Features

- Live dual-axis chart with a selectable time window (60 s to 24 h, or auto)
- Four chart tabs: V/A, accumulated Capacity (Ah/Wh), D+/D-, and Temperature
- Session recording with 10-second aggregation buckets stored in IndexedDB
- CSV export of any recorded session, with local-timezone timestamps
- PNG screenshot of any chart tab, stamped with the start and end time
- Demo mode: synthetic data trace runs automatically so the UI is explorable without a device
- Disconnect freeze: chart holds the last frame when the device disconnects

## Compatible devices

- FNIRSI FNB58
- FNIRSI FNB48
- FNIRSI FNB38

All three use the RFstar transparent UART BLE profile (service UUID ffe0/ffe5, CRC16-XMODEM framing).

## Technical details

- Pure client-side HTML/CSS/JavaScript, no build step
- Web Bluetooth API (Chrome or Edge required)
- BLE protocol: RFstar UART, service ffe0 (notify) + ffe5 (write)
- Local storage: IndexedDB (no data leaves the browser)
- Chart rendered on an HTML5 Canvas element
